enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Bend knees. Turn onto back. Move arm to side. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Lie still. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Roll onto stomach. Turn to right side.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower tap. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Rub soap on body. Rinse body. Turn off shower tap. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, toasting bread and eating breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Press kettle switch. Open refrigerator. Take out bread, butter, jam. Close refrigerator. Open bread bag. Take out two slices. Place slices in toaster. Press toaster lever. Place tea bag in mug and pour hot water. Toast pops up. Take toast out. Place on plate. Spread butter and jam. Carry plate and mug to table. Sit down. Eat toast. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking phone and computer for news about the transport strike and email updates
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into living room. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open news app. Scroll through news. Read transport strike article. Open email app. Check email. Reply to email. Put down phone. Open computer. Turn on computer. Open web browser. Navigate to news site. Read transport strike updates. Open email client. Check new emails. Reply to email. Close computer. Put down computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and tidying the room
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt, pants, underwear, socks. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Pick up pajamas. Fold pajamas. Put pajamas in drawer. Close drawer. Pick up clothes from floor. Hang clothes in wardrobe. Make bed. Fluff pillow. Pull blanket. Smooth sheet. Pick up trash and throw in bin.

enriched_activities.activity: Working remotely on the computer, coordinating community programs and answering emails
enriched_activities.desc: Sit down at desk. Turn on computer. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Open document. Edit program plan. Make phone call. Speak on phone. Hang up. Open spreadsheet. Update budget. Join video call. Speak on video call. Share screen. End video call. Save document. Close computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating lunch using the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Place vegetables on cutting board. Chop vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil into pan. Add vegetables and meat. Stir. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Pick up plate. Serve food onto plate. Carry plate to table. Sit down. Eat lunch.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short break, stretching and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into living room. Sit down on sofa. Pick up remote control. Press power button to turn on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Stand up. Stretch arms. Stretch legs. Bend forward. Twist torso. Sit down again. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll through social media. Put down phone. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing remote work on the computer, joining video calls and updating program plans
enriched_activities.desc: Sit down at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Check emails. Open document. Update program plans. Save document. Join video call. Speak on video call. Share screen. Take notes. End video call. Open email again. Reply to emails. Make phone call. Speak on phone. Hang up. Open spreadsheet. Update data. Close computer.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place ingredients on counter. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil into pan. Add ingredients. Stir. Add spices. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Pick up plate. Serve food onto plate. Set table. Pick up utensils. Place utensils on table.

Sit down at table. Pick up fork. Pick up knife. Cut food. Lift fork to mouth. Chew. Swallow. Take a sip of water. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Continue eating. Pick up plate. Carry plate to sink. Turn on tap. Rinse plate. Turn off tap. Place plate in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Wipe counter. Walk out of kitchen.

Walk into living room. Sit down on sofa. Pick up remote control. Press power button to turn on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Check social media. Put down phone. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Stretch arms. Sit down again. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bathroom. Turn on light and water heater. Turn on shower tap. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Rub soap on body. Rinse body. Pick up shampoo. Apply shampoo to hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower tap. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body with towel. Dry hair with towel. Turn off water heater. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and browsing on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into living room. Sit down on sofa. Pick up book. Open book to page. Read. Turn page. Read. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll. Like post. Put down phone. Pick up book. Read. Turn page. Close book. Put down book. Stand up.

Walk into bedroom. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Set alarm. Put down phone. Pull blanket. Lie down on bed. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Stretch legs. Turn onto back. Breathe deeply. Move arm. Turn to left side again. Lie still.
